set -euo pipefail
REPO=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomaps/work
SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
cd "$REPO"
git fetch origin main --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git switch --detach "$SHA"
cd frontend
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
cd ..
test -f frontend/dist/index.html
rsync -az --delete frontend/dist/ michal@192.168.0.23:/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/frontend/dist/
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; PHOTOMAP_SKIP_FRONTEND_BUILD=1 ./scripts/serverctl.sh start; ./scripts/serverctl.sh status; ./scripts/serverctl.sh tunnel-status; echo ---LISTEN---; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep :8000; echo ---LOCAL---; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health; echo; echo ---LAN---; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 5 http://192.168.0.23:8000/health || true; echo ---PUBLIC---; curl -fsSI --max-time 15 https://photomap.pl/ | sed -n "1,12p"; echo ---PUBLIC_HEALTH---; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 https://photomap.pl/health; echo DEPLOYED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
html=Path('frontend/dist/index.html').read_text()
assets=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/assets/[^"\']+', html)))
print('LOCAL_ASSETS')
for a in assets: print(a)
public=subprocess.check_output(['curl','-fsSL','--max-time','15','https://photomap.pl/'], text=True)
public_assets=sorted(set(re.findall(r'/assets/[^"\']+', public)))
print('PUBLIC_ASSETS')
for a in public_assets: print(a)
if assets != public_assets:
    raise SystemExit('public assets do not match local build')
PY
echo verified_sha=$SHA
